schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Details
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: FEI Helios NanoLab G3 CX (Kyoto Univ): e-beam Pt coating at 5 kV; Ga+ Pt coating at 30 kV; section thinned to ~100 nm at 30 kV Ga+; cleaned at 5 kV Ga+; additional Ar ion milling (Fischione NanoMill, ultra-low energy, Kyushu Univ)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: FE-SEM imaging of the soil grains before sectioning — grains were coated with 3 nm of osmium and observed "using a field-emission (FE) scanning electron microscope (JSM-7001F) at Kyushu University", with "Secondary high-resolution electron imaging ... at a low accelerating voltage of 2.0 kV under high vacuum" and EDX "used to determine the mineral phases on the grain" (p.2); the section was then cut where the iron sulfides are exposed (p.3)
